component.name: core.openwop.connections.avalara
component.description: Avalara AvaTax connection pack (RFC 0095) — api_key provider for the commerce tax-quote seam (ADR 0250), the second tax provider alongside TaxJar. Category is `other` (openai-images precedent): the normative `category` enum has no `tax` value and the seam resolves by `id` (`avalara`), not category — no wire/RFC change. When a merchant configures an Avalara connection (and no TaxJar one), `features/commerce/taxShipping.ts` calls AvaTax createTransaction (POST https://rest.avatax.com/api/v2/transactions/create, Basic auth over the account:licenseKey secret) at checkout and reads `totalTax`; ANY error/timeout falls back to the flat/manual governance rate — a tax-provider hiccup never blocks a sale. READ quotes (not money movement), so NO commerce-spend gate. Credentials stay host-side via the Connections broker; the request carries only the destination address + line amount, never customer contact details. Carries NO secret (ADR 0024 §7).
